terms.grammar: adjective, agreeing with the noun for the whole
terms.comment: Latin says the part with an adjective agreeing with the whole: in summā arbore, at the top of the tree (see the top of).
Our description, for when the part is spoken of by itself; Latin more often makes the part an adjective.

sources: Descriptions and prompts labelled as ours are composed for family conversation. Recorded vocabulary does not imply universal technical standardization.
